title: centaurea axillaris var. atrata
intro: Centaurea axillaris var. atrata, commonly known as Black knapweed, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea axillaris var. atrata include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
